resampling: Within each fixed product sample 18 value families with replacement, retain four variants, then sample one seed per selected scenario occurrence independently per model; use that seed jointly across budgets and metrics. Families sampled jointly across models.
simultaneous_panel: Six accuracy-minus-utility private threshold differences; exploratory maximum-standardized-deviation 95% bands.
ratio_interval_caveat: Ratio intervals condition on positive utility thresholds. Primary difference intervals and bands retain every draw, including nonpositive thresholds. A nonpositive signed threshold means high/high is not supported at positive cost.

example.interpretation: Bootstrap stability frequency, not a posterior or market probability.

limits: Conditional on constructed tasks, three fixed products, original prompts and scoring CDF; excludes market shift, construction-split uncertainty, model/protocol misspecification and estimated client selection/value.
